svg.title: FlashFusion three-layer system map
svg.desc: Three horizontal layers stacked vertically. Bottom: Revenue Engine (teal, active). Middle: Delivery Engine (purple). Top: Product Engine (amber, future). Each layer contains three nodes. Upward arrows between gaps show bottom-up funding flow.
